lines.26: When I came to my senses, the Princess was staring straight at me.
lines.28: Heat flooded my face in an instant, and I reflexively looked away.
lines.29: The Princess saw that and gave me a knowing grin.
lines.30: 「One reason I brought your group in...」
lines.31: 「...is that you're so much fun to tease.」
lines.33: 「Exactly. Your face is bright red even now.」
lines.34: 「But I suppose I'll let you off for today.」
lines.36: As if she had already grown bored, the Princess waved me away.
lines.38: As she spoke, she booted up the computer.
lines.40: And yet, even that behavior looked beautiful to me.
lines.41: Her desktop background was a cute cat, which reassured me a little.
